end.summary:
Matched numerals to groups of the same amount, including using claps; shown with a why/new-situation question.
Matched number names such as one/ek to numerals in practice; a why/new-situation check is still needed.
Read and wrote numerals, including telling 6 from 9 by the position of the round part; shown with a why/new-situation question.
Identified zero for none using empty plates, no runs, and no birds; shown with a why/new-situation question.
end.parentNote: Asha practised numerals 1–9 and zero with Aarav through claps, number order, and examples such as an empty plate and a zero cricket score. Aarav used the position of the round part to tell 6 and 9 apart, and connected zero with “nothing.” Number names such as one/ek were practised with easy questions; next time, ask a why or new-situation question, such as matching “five” to 5 in a new group. At home, show small groups of objects and ask Aarav to say the number name, choose the numeral, and explain how they know.
